notes.scope: EVERY key in this file is read by code. Keys that no code read were deleted rather than left in place: an inert tunable is worse than no tunable, because editing it looks like it does something. Before adding a key here, add the reader first.

readers.version: cc_memory/cli/mem.py:64-70 and cc_memory/mcp/server.py:108-116, both as the LAST-RESORT version fallback for a flat standalone install. core/version.py:25 __version__ is canonical; this literal must agree with it.
readers.consolidation.auto_interval_sessions: cc_memory/hooks/consolidate_async.py:69-80 (_auto_interval); non-positive or unparseable falls back to 5.
readers.ccl.enabled / ccl.ollama_url / ccl.local: cc_memory/llm/ccl_backend.py:36-52 (_load_local_config). The local Ollama fallback is OPT-IN: enabled=false means the Anthropic legs (env key -> Claude Code OAuth token, each with its own wire format) are the only backends.

notes.excluded_projects_usage: Absolute paths of projects that opt OUT of cc-memory entirely. A listed directory, and anything beneath it, gets no memory/ directory, no memory.db, no extraction and no PROGRESS.md - the two hooks that would create them exit 0 immediately. Matching is on the RESOLVED absolute path and is case-insensitive on Windows, case-sensitive elsewhere. Relative entries and ~ are expanded. Example: ["D:\\Private\\client-work", "/home/me/secret-project"]. This is the only opt-out; there is no per-project override file.
notes.removed_keys: extraction.*, writer.*, injection.*, observation.*, idle_reorg.*, archive.*, modes.default, web_viewer.port, mcp.auto_register and logging.* were declared here and read by NO code - two independent audits measured 34 of 51 leaf keys with no Python reader. The live values are module constants; change them there, not here: writer thresholds llm/memory_writer.py:44-47, injection budgets hooks/session_start.py:54 and :56-62, idle reorg interval core/idle.py:35, observation skip-list core/modes.py:17-21 (per mode), web viewer port ui/web_viewer.py:668. mcp.auto_register never had an implementation - MCP registration is the mcpServers block in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
